name: scribe
description: Independent end-to-end skills for reusable Knowledge systems, company Product and Technical Documentation, Project architecture delivery, professional writing, presentation manuscripts, and technical visuals.

interface.shortDescription: Structure and write documents and deck manuscripts.
interface.longDescription: Choose one complete skill to organize reusable Knowledge, write company documentation or Project architecture delivery, produce a presentation manuscript, or create a verified visual. Shared methods are applied internally.
defaultPrompt: Use $Ask Scribe to identify the single Scribe skill that owns my requested result and return its complete invocation.
Use $Structure Docs to plan a coherent documentation structure and migration map.
Use $Write Deck to turn this material into a coherent Markdown presentation manuscript.
Use $Draw Diagram to create and verify one useful visual for this document.
